lastCompletedStory.title: Wire cam issue close <id> positional subcommand

nextStoryContext: US-002 added `close <id>` to parseIssueArgs (ParsedIssueArgs gained { mode: 'close'; id: string; help: false }, checked at the top of the function alongside `list`, before the --file-local/free-text branches) and a matching dispatchIssue branch. The branch injects at the PRIMITIVE level: IssueDispatchDeps.closeIssueOnMainFn?: (id: string) => CloseIssueOnMainOutcome (same name/shape already used by ship-pr.ts's ShipPrOptions), defaulting to defaultCloseIssueFn(process.cwd(), id) imported from src/release/post-merge.ts (reuses the existing real-spawnSync+clock wiring; do NOT duplicate a spawnFn closure inline in index.ts). dispatchIssue's close branch owns ALL printing: printHint(`closed ${result.id} on main (${result.sha})`) on ok:true plus process.stdout.write(`CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=${result.id}\n`) and return 0; on !ok, printError(...) plus process.stdout.write(`CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=ERROR reason=${result.reason}\n`) and return 1. ISSUE_HELP now documents 'close <id>' and the usage line. US-003 (wire `cam issue abandon <id>`) should mirror this exact shape 1:1 against abandonIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-specify.ts, already implemented and tested in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts): add { mode: 'abandon'; id } to ParsedIssueArgs, a parse branch alongside close/list, and an IssueDispatchDeps.abandonIssueOnMainFn?: (id: string) => AbandonIssueOnMainOutcome seam with a production default (check whether post-merge.ts/ship-pr.ts already has a defaultAbandonIssueFn-equivalent before writing a new spawnFn+clock closure inline; if not, consider adding one next to defaultCloseIssueFn in post-merge.ts to keep the jscpd-avoidance convention). AbandonIssueOnMainError reasons are diverged/detached-head/missing-main | not-found | already-abandoned (mirrors CloseIssueOnMainError's shape exactly, per issue-specify.ts). Two test files share a naming collision to watch for: test/issue-dispatch.test.ts (this story's parseIssueArgs/dispatchIssue tests, top-level test/) vs test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts (abandonIssueOnMain/closeIssueOnMain primitive coverage, nested test/commands/) -- do not confuse the two when adding US-003 tests.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal TS CLI-dispatch wiring reusing existing internal primitives (closeIssueOnMain, defaultCloseIssueFn); no external library API surface touched.
